title: New user? Start now · the AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 lab
description: For new users of the AI Foundry lab's three machines and four ET-SoC-1 cards: how to get access, the lab's rules on one screen, and a self-contained brief to paste into a coding agent (Claude Code or similar) so that it sets you up safely: what it may and may not do and why, a first-hour checklist with exact commands, the traps of 23–30 September with their fixes, how to measure so results hold, how to leave the lab clean, and where to ask.
